\newcommand{\PaperTitle}{Autonomous Shopping Optimizer}
\newcommand{\PaperSubtitle}{Exact stopping decisions under time, token, API, and purchase-price limits}
\newcommand{\PaperAuthors}{Ahnaf Prio\\{\small Independent Researcher}}
\newcommand{\PaperAbstract}{Autonomous Shopping Optimizer is middleware for sequential merchant search under hard time, token, API-call, API-spend, and purchase-price limits. Its exact finite-horizon planner tracks remaining resources, chooses the next feasible merchant, and returns buy, continue, or reject without executing an LLM call or a purchase. Before each call it can issue enforceable timeout, token, call, and spend permits, then reconcile actual usage. The current research asks whether adaptive permit allocation improves purchase quality or success over fixed feasible baselines while maintaining zero hard-budget violations.}
\newcommand{\PaperKeywords}{autonomous shopping, online search, optimal stopping, resource constraints, ephemeral offers}
